Food through fire

The Journey of Grilling

Grillardin - a French word traditionally associated with a chef skilled in grilling—is our celebration of the art, craft, and evolution of grilling across centuries.

Grilling is among the oldest and most universal methods of cooking, yet it has remained one of the most creative and adaptable. From the earliest days of cooking a fresh catch over a slow, open fire to the sophisticated grilling techniques we experience today, fire has brought people together around food.

In its earliest forms, grilling was simple and communal. Meat, fish, and vegetables were marinated, stuffed, or cooked on the bone over live fire. What began as a practical way of preparing food gradually became an integral part of celebrations and social gatherings. As culinary traditions evolved, so did the methods—from open fires and charcoal to hot plates, roasting pits, and purpose-built grills.

Grilling is also a remarkably wholesome way of cooking. When thoughtfully executed, it allows the natural flavours and juices of the ingredients and proteins to take centre stage, creating dishes that are both deeply flavourful and beautifully expressive.

Across the world, grilling takes many forms: hot plates, barbecue grills, and roasting pits are central to numerous culinary traditions. In the Indian subcontinent, tandoors, lava stones, and charcoal grills form an essential part of the grilling repertoire. Across Asia, teppanyaki, tabletop grilling, and Korean barbecue have transformed grilling into an immersive dining experience where cooking itself becomes part of the meal.

Grillardin is born from our passion for this timeless craft. It is an endeavour to bring together diverse grilling techniques, traditions, and experiences under one roof—celebrating the remarkable journey of food through fire.

Because there is something uniquely special about gathering around a grill: sharing a meal, discovering flavours from across the world, and enjoying the company of friends and family.

For us, that is the true celebration of grilling.

We are delighted that you have chosen Grillardin to be a part of your gourmet journey

Come hungry. Stay a little.

Every journey
